memory_candidates.content: AskUserQuestion cannot be invoked from bash scripts — it must be called inline in SKILL.md as Claude executes the skill. When a skill needs user interaction, embed the AskUserQuestion call as pseudocode/prose instructions in the SKILL.md, and extract all bash side effects into a separate shared script. This pattern was implemented in Stage 4a of 6 skill SKILL.md files for the --lit flag detection flow.
